methods.label: Apply the Pythagorean theorem
methods.explanation:
The diagonal and two adjacent sides of the rectangular screen form a right triangle, so the Pythagorean theorem connects the given ratio to the diagonal length.

[Figure 1](figures/2003_AMC_10B_Q06_question_fig1.svg)

Since width to height is \(4:3\), write the width as \(4t\) inches and the height as \(3t\) inches, where \(t>0\). If the diagonal is \(d\) inches, then
\[
d^2=(4t)^2+(3t)^2=25t^2.
\]
Because lengths are positive, \(d=5t\). The \(27\)-inch diagonal therefore gives \(t=27/5\), and the width is
\[
4t=4\left(\frac{27}{5}\right)=21.6\text{ inches}.
\]
This is \(0.1\) inch from \(21.5\) and \(0.4\) inch from \(22\); the other choices are all at most \(21\), so they are farther away. The closest choice is \(\boxed{21.5}\) inches, choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
